During the holiday season, electronic and furniture products purchased between Nov 17 and Dec 24, 2019 may be returned until Jan 11, 2020 or as regular policy allows, whichever is later.
rules.quote:
During the holiday season, we are extending our regular 14–day electronic and furniture return policy to permit customers to return products that may be purchased as gifts.

Any electronic or furniture products, which usually fall within the 14–day return policy, purchased between November 17, 2019 and December 24, 2019 may be returned until January 11, 2020 or as regular policy allows, whichever is later.
